categories.name: Own Choice Volunteering
categories.subtitle: You can use your professional skills, experience and networks to help a registered UK charity or state-funded school

benefitImpactDescriptions.Short Commitment: Just 1.5 hours, making it easy to fit into your schedule
benefitImpactDescriptions.Accelerate Personal & Professional Growt: By engaging with students and facilitating learning, you enhance your own communication, mentoring, and presentation skills. Skills that are valuable in both personal growth and professional settings
benefitImpactDescriptions.Reflection and Growth: Reflect on educational equity and impact
benefitImpactDescriptions.Leadership Development: Fundraising often involves taking on leadership roles, developing skills like delegation, motivation, and team building.
benefitImpactDescriptions.Enhanced Skills: Fundraising involves developing skills like communication, organisation, event planning, problem solving and relationship building

opportunities.title: Sharing Your Career Journey
opportunities.description: Sharing Your Career Journey is the act of openly discussing your professional experiences, successes, challenges, and lessons learned with colleagues or others, aiming to inspire, guide, and support their own career growth.
opportunities.contactNote: If you are interested in sharing your career journey, get in touch with our team

opportunities.title: Rise Employability workshop
opportunities.description: Rise is an initiative that aims to boost social mobility in the UK by helping young people develop the essential skills that businesses need. The Seven Steps to Rise workshop consists of a carousel of challenges designed for students aged 14-15.
opportunities.contactNote: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.

opportunities.title: Opening Doors to Opportunities – In-Office Edition
opportunities.description: Opening Doors to Opportunities invites schools into our offices across the UK, as part of our commitment we’ve made to give one million young people the opportunity to develop their skills by 2030. We’re asking colleagues to help us to ‘open doors,’ by supporting 2-hour workplace visits at offices across the UK. Volunteers support the students with their activities and talk to them about working somewhere like KPMG. You do not need to have experience with young people or specific numeracy knowledge as you will be fully supported throughout. We are looking for volunteers of any grade and area of the business.
opportunities.contactNote: KPMG Opening Doors to Opportunities: Office Edition - Volunteer Sign Up Form - 2026-27
opportunities.cardDescription: Opening Doors to Opportunities invites schools into our offices across the UK, as part of our commitment we’ve made to give one million young people the opportunity to develop their skills by 2030.

opportunities.title: National Charity volunteering
opportunities.description: KPMG are working with FELIX to turn surplus food into social change and strengthen communities across the UK. There are many ways in which you can get involved.

subPrograms.title: Fundraise for FELIX
subPrograms.description: Learn about the different ways you can help to raise funds. For every £1 we raise through our partnership, Felix will be able to redistribute the equivalent of 5 meals to those who need it most.

subPrograms.title: Volunteer for FELIX
subPrograms.description: Volunteering with Felix supports social impact, builds teamwork, boosts well-being, and develops skills. From packing food to cooking meals or creating care parcels, your time makes a meaningful difference.

subPrograms.title: Warehouse volunteering
subPrograms.description: Warehouse volunteering at FareShare involves sorting surplus food, picking orders, assisting deliveries, and sometimes cooking meals for communities. Join individually or as a group to support those in need.

subPrograms.title: Create care parcels for the community
subPrograms.description: Bring your team together to prepare and deliver food parcels for local Felix charities. Choose your office, date, and team size to take part in this rewarding initiative and make a meaningful difference in your local community.

opportunities.contactNote: Get involved with Felix to turn surplus food into social change

opportunities.title: Inspire world of work visits
opportunities.description: Inspire World of Work visits have been designed to give primary schools in London access to our offices to give them insight into the world of work and help them develop essential future skills by taking on the challenges facing our clients.
opportunities.contactNote: Timing to be confirmed. Register now via Microsoft Forms

opportunities.title: Opening Doors to Opportunities – In-School Edition
opportunities.description:
This employability skills programme supports secondary school pupils in social mobility coldspots with essential employability skills all over the UK. Volunteers can support the programme virtually or in-person.

The workshops are fully led by an external facilitator and educate students about the future world of work, encouraging them to develop their digital literacy and green skills.
opportunities.contactNote: KPMG Opening Doors to Opportunities: In-School Edition - Volunteer Sign Up Form - 2026-27
opportunities.cardDescription: This employability skills programme supports secondary school pupils in social mobility coldspots with essential employability skills all over the UK. Volunteers can support the programme virtually or in-person.

opportunities.title: Action Tutoring
opportunities.description: Action Tutoring offers free maths and English support to disadvantaged pupils. Volunteers tutor virtually or in-school, with full training and materials provided. No prior teaching experience required. Support is available throughout.
opportunities.contactNote: Join our tutoring network to support students across the UK

opportunities.title: UpReach
opportunities.description: UpReach partners with KPMG to help disadvantaged students to reach their potential through mentoring, career advice, and industry insights.
opportunities.contactNote: All grades and levels of experience are welcome to apply If you are interested, please contact daniel.navarrete@kpmg.co.uk

opportunities.title: The Switch – Virtual Volunteering
opportunities.description: Flexible virtual sessions ranging from 30 mins to 1.5 hours, perfect if you want to volunteer from your desk. Support students with topics like careers, interviews, CVs and managing money.
opportunities.additionalText: Sign up: View sessions here

Inspiration for All is a 9-month mentoring programme pairing KPMG leaders with UK school heads to grow leadership skills.

opportunities.description: STEM Ambassadors inspire young people in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics, opening doors to exciting career pathways. This is a self-organised volunteering opportunity. To register as a STEM Ambassador, you will need to Register your interest here.

opportunities.description: Governance roles such as school governor or trustee are a fantastic way to give back to your community and make a real difference in the lives of young people. It's a commitment that comes with a lot of responsibility, but the rewards are truly enriching.
opportunities.contactNote: To find out more about becoming a school governor, contact our team below

opportunities.title: Charity Trustee
opportunities.description: Being a charity trustee is a significant commitment requiring time, dedication, and a willingness to learn. However, the benefits are substantial, both for the charity and for the individual.
